findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 1 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Switzer and Switzer, but the page renders Inter, Outfit.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The margins differ: 152px on the left, 198px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("技術文章") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.

findings.message: 18 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "批量查詢 ICP 備案狀態：幾百個網域怎麼查才不會被擋" → 3 lines (3 words, 24.3px); "no-cache 不是「不要快取」：HTTP 快取標頭的實際語意" → 3 lines (3 words, 24.3px); "GeoDNS 為什麼會把使用者導到錯的節點：它看的是解析器，不是你" → 3 lines (2 words, 24.3px); "免費憑證與付費憑證差在哪：不是加密強度，也不是萬用字元" → 3 lines (1 words, 24.3px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
